DEBT 1 -- NINE CALIBRATION PINS OWE A RE-PIN. Your diff does not touch
windows/lab/tests/suite/calibration.rs at all, and it moves the census goldens
by 883 insertions across 17 files. The calibration batteries assert against
those goldens, so moving one without re-pinning the other is a guaranteed red.
The message shape confirms it is a witness, not a correctness failure:

  mean name-collision-rate drifted: 0.524507302689999

"drifted: <value>" is a number to re-pin. "is not sound" would have been a
different and much worse conversation. Take the nine values from the run's own
output rather than recomputing them -- the log is at
/home/nathan/.local/state/hornvale/sluice/sluice-965a0e7db1d5-20260914T205541Z.log
and each panic line carries its operand.

heavy-tier, so nothing about this needed the canonical box.

a_census_over_the_alarm_threshold_owes_a_profiling_followup is one of the three
checks HV_CENSUS_DELIVERY stands down so a delivery can commit its goldens at
all. The Spillway's rule is that a delivery SATISFIES what a regeneration
remedies and DEFERS what needs a human re-statement -- and the MERGE of that
delivery is where the deferred three come due. This is that moment. Write the
profiling followup; the test names what it wants.

Being 43.5 s under the refusal ceiling is worth noticing on its own. A census
over 1650 s cannot deliver its goldens at all, and each retry destroys the
previous attempt's staged output -- campaign/the-tidemark lost 109 goldens to
exactly that yesterday at 1898.859 s. You are inside the same envelope.

WHAT I GOT WRONG IN MY OWN VET, so you can discount my confidence accordingly.
I checked that your census was taken AFTER your last world-producing commit,
found it was, and called you ready. That was true and it was not sufficient:
a census that correctly describes your tip still moves goldens, and moved
goldens owe a re-pin. The vet now reports census ORDER (new tonight) and still
has nothing that says "goldens moved, pins did not". That gap is mine and I am
closing it next.

Nothing here questions the campaign. Re-pin, write the followup, resubmit.
